exit_band_20260806.exemption_reason: BUILD-PHASE + EVENT-PROVISIONAL FV + BROKEN BOOK. (1) We hold 200 sh of a ruled 560-sh forward target (36%) with two buy rungs resting below market (200 @ 40.50, 160 @ 39.00). (2) The FV set (bear 38 / base 44 / bull 54) is PROVISIONAL by the record's own adjudication: the PWBK acquisition closes inside Q3, issues 430,176 new shares (~5.8% dilution), and the 424B3 was VERIFIED to contain ZERO pro-forma statements and ZERO credit-mark/PCD disclosure - the day-one mark on an impaired acquired book (PWBK NPLs 2.92%) is unknowable pre-close. Trimming into a merger-arb tape against an FV that cannot yet be computed is not 'selling a pop', it is selling blind. (3) The court's own execution rule is 'limit-only, float-gated' on a 7.3M-share float whose book is currently bid 17.27 / ask 68.32 - a resting sell here has no reliable reference price. Instrumented via a forcing alert.
